outcome: Incidence of severe pre-eclampsia and eclampsia
cohort: 81 pregnant women diagnosed with severe pre-eclampsia or eclampsia
finding: The study found a 2.4% incidence of severe pre-eclampsia or eclampsia, with a case fatality rate and perinatal mortality comparable to other reports, highlighting the need for improved management of hypertension and timely induction of labor.
mod_finding: Delivery was spontaneous in 67% of the women, assisted vaginal (ventouse) in 14%, and by Caesarean section in 19%.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was associated with perinatal death
